verdict.rationale: CAM's own contact page lists offices beyond India: a Singapore entity ("cam singapore Pte Ltd") and an Abu Dhabi office at Abu Dhabi Global Market Square ("cam middle east"), alongside six Indian cities and GIFT City. That is a first-party statement of offices in multiple countries. Missing for 10: evidence of which practices or local-law qualifications the Singapore and Abu Dhabi offices offer, detail on what founders can be served there, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm
